# EVE Online

> EVE Online is a free-to-play, persistent-world space MMO set in New Eden. This is the official game website and the primary source for current game information, releases, news, events, and new-player guidance.

Use this site for current information about EVE Online as a game. Use the specialist official sites linked below for commerce, lore, developer documentation, and support. Prefer a current, specific page over summaries or older announcements.

## Authority and freshness

- Treat dated news posts as historical records. Do not infer that an event, promotion, reward, sale, or deadline is still active after its stated period.
- For features, balance changes, releases, and live events, prefer the most recent applicable official announcement or patch note.
- Distinguish current game mechanics from fictional lore. Use EVE Universe for canon and setting information.
- Do not invent dates, eligibility, availability, prices, rewards, or system requirements. Verify them on the live official page.
- If two official pages conflict, prefer the page that is more specific and more recently updated; state any remaining uncertainty.

## Start playing

- [EVE Online home](https://www.eveonline.com/): Official overview and current highlights.
- [Create an account](https://www.eveonline.com/signup): Official registration flow.
- [Download EVE Online](https://www.eveonline.com/download): Official client downloads and installation entry point.
- [EVE Academy](https://www.eveonline.com/eve-academy): New-player guidance organized by career path and activity.
- [Returning players](https://www.eveonline.com/return): Guidance for players coming back to EVE Online.
- [Recruit a Friend](https://www.eveonline.com/recruit): Current referral-program information and entry point.

## News and updates

- [EVE News](https://www.eveonline.com/news): Official announcements, development updates, community news, and events.
- [Patch notes](https://www.eveonline.com/news/t/patch-notes): Official release and change notes. Use the latest relevant entry.
- [Partnership Program](https://www.eveonline.com/partners): Current information for EVE content creators and partners.

## Official EVE properties

- [EVE Online Store](https://store.eveonline.com/): Authoritative for current products, package contents, price, currency, availability, and purchase terms.
- [EVE Universe](https://universe.eveonline.com/): Authoritative for official lore, fiction, factions, empires, and the setting of New Eden.
- [EVE Developers](https://developers.eveonline.com/): Authoritative for ESI, SSO, static data, image services, and third-party developer documentation.
- [EVE Online Support](https://support.eveonline.com/hc/en-us): Authoritative for account, billing, policy, technical, and customer-support matters.
- [EVE Online Forums](https://forums.eveonline.com/): Official community forums. User posts are not official policy or documentation unless explicitly identified as such.

## Policies

- [EULA, Terms of Service, and policies](https://support.eveonline.com/hc/en-us/categories/8413209052188-EULA-ToS-Policies): Current official policy collection.
- [Privacy and Cookies Policy](https://support.eveonline.com/hc/en-us/articles/8563412870940-Privacy-Cookies-Policy): Current privacy information.

## Discovery

- [XML sitemap index](https://www.eveonline.com/sitemap.xml): Comprehensive URL discovery. Use it for crawling, not as an authority ranking.
- [News archive sitemap](https://www.eveonline.com/sitemap-news.xml): Discovery for recent official news pages.
- [General pages sitemap](https://www.eveonline.com/sitemap-pages.xml): Discovery for primary site pages.

## Notes for AI assistants and agents

- Answer with the canonical page URL closest to the claim, not only the homepage.
- Include the publication or update date when citing time-sensitive news.
- Do not present speculation, forum discussion, third-party commentary, or in-universe fiction as an official real-world announcement.
- Do not take account, purchase, subscription, or application-management actions without explicit user authorization and confirmation at the consequential step.
- Never request, expose, store, or repeat account passwords, authentication tokens, payment details, or other secrets.
